title: Replaces top-level price fields with improved price modeling on Invoice Items and Invoice Line Items
changed: other Price field reads, InvoiceItem.unit_amount and unit_amount_decimal removed
price and unit_amount request parameters removed from invoiceItems.create/update
lines[].price removed from invoices.addLines and invoices.updateLines
reason: The recorded stripe/openapi contracts do not declare plan on line_item or invoiceitem, so findRemovedProperties reports no removal.

parts.how: The traced read stays unresolved and goes to the agent fixer (pipeline/stripe-agent.ts) with AI on; the generated read helper was deleted (docs/GUT-PLAN.md).

changed: other Price field reads, InvoiceItem.unit_amount and unit_amount_decimal removed
parts.how: findRemovedProperties (specifications.ts) reports the removed field and analyzeRepository (analyzer.ts) reports each traced read as a confirmed finding; STRIPE_MOVE_REVIEW (stripe-field-moves.ts) appends the named Stripe reason where it has one. No rule edits the read, so a deterministic patch leaves it unresolved and the AI patch path (run.ts aiFindings, ai-patches.ts proposeAiPatch) receives it.

parts.reason: The recorded stripe/openapi contracts do not declare plan on line_item or invoiceitem, so findRemovedProperties reports no removal.

changed: price and unit_amount request parameters removed from invoiceItems.create/update
parts.reason: Not mapped: the adapter names POST /v1/invoiceitems `invoiceitems.create` from its URL (stripe-operations.ts stripeContractOperations, stripe-benchmark.ts stripeOperations), but stripe-node calls it `invoiceItems.create`, so the call is not traced and no finding names it. (Under fullDiff, oasdiff can still report the operation's change when another mapped call returns the same object, which stops the whole run without naming this call.)

changed: lines[].price removed from invoices.addLines and invoices.updateLines
parts.reason: Only with fullDiff (oasdiff; the watch worker default, off in `refit run` and in the benchmark fix stage): compareOpenApi (openapi-diff.ts) reports the request change and findBreakingOperationImpacts (provider-operations.ts) lists every traced call of that operation as an operation impact, which blocks AI and stops the run in scanReviewReason (workflow.ts), whether or not the call sends the changed value. Without fullDiff Refit reports nothing.
